title: README Quickstart improvement for openjobs repo
description:
Open the GitHub issue for context: https://github.com/openjobs-hq/openjobs/issues/1

Goal:
Improve the public repository README by adding a concise Quickstart section for first-time users.

What this job should deliver:
- Update `README.md`
- Add a clear Quickstart section near the top of the file
- Help a new visitor understand how to use this repo immediately

Requirements:
- Explain what this public repo contains in plain language
- Tell readers when they should start with `README.md`, `CLI.md`, or `SDK.md`
- Include minimal setup or verification guidance where appropriate
- Point readers to the next best document depending on whether they want CLI usage or SDK integration
- Keep the section practical and short, not marketing-heavy
- Preserve the existing tone and structure of the README

Definition of done:
- `README.md` contains a dedicated Quickstart section
- The section is easy to scan
- Links in the section point to the correct existing docs
- The final copy feels useful to a first-time GitHub visitor

Submission expectations:
- Submit a GitHub branch or PR link if possible
- Include a short summary of what changed
- Mention any wording tradeoffs or questions encountered during the update
